thread:
Gita: quick follow-up from the postmortem on the tokenizer-worker OOMs. we've seen near-identical failures on 2026-01-12, 2026-02-09, and 2026-03-14. need owners + jira + a clear handoff so remediation actually ships.
Omar: i'll take investigation (R). creating RWD-30221 now. aiming to post repro steps and a small perf trace by EOD Thu.
Lin: i'll own the mitigation & rollout (A). opening RWD-30222 for the patch + canary. plan is a soft cap + streaming chunking fallback.
Carla: i'll consult on alerts and customer impact comms (C). will draft an alert and a short status blurb for PS.
Gita: proposed RACI: Omar=R, Lin=A, Carla=C, Gita=I (pm). confirm?
Omar: confirmed. early triage: tokenizer spikes memory when ingesting mixed-format prompts with large embedded examples. sample log snippet:
```
2026-03-14T06:42:11Z tokenizer-3 error: runtime: out of memory, alloc=1340MB
2026-03-14T06:42:11Z tokenizer-3 warn: example_embed_len=2, example_size_kb=812
```
Omar: suspected cause: eager concatenation of examples before streaming + per-request allocation peak. next steps in RWD-30221: (1) reproduce with mixed-format harness (2) add allocator histos + max-alloc guard (3) propose safe chunking approach.
Lin: mitigation plan in RWD-30222: (1) enforce soft_max_alloc=900MB, (2) implement streaming-chunking for examples >64KB, (3) add graceful degrade path that falls back to smaller batch size. will coordinate canary.
Carla: alerting: proposing RWD-30223 - warning at tokenizer_mem > 900MB for 5m, page at >1100MB for 2m. also will add a runbook with rollback steps.
Gita: gating: no rollout until canary shows tokenizer_mem p95/p99 <= baseline for 48h and no OOM regressions in sandbox. add gating to RWD-30222 and RWD-30223.
Omar: added gating note to RWD-30221 and linked RWD-30222/30223. tagging ops-bot to create a weekly check-in. @ops-bot please schedule a recurring 30m sync until both tickets are closed.
ops-bot: Created Jira tickets RWD-30221 (investigation), RWD-30222 (mitigation), RWD-30223 (alerting). Created recurring event "Tokenizer OOM remediation" starting 2026-03-22 09:30 PT weekly. Invites sent to Omar, Lin, Carla, Gita.
Lin: draft PR up for chunking fallback, linking RWD-30222. assigning Omar & Carla as reviewers. small refactor + unit tests.
Omar: reviewing now. small nit on buffer reuse but otherwise LGTM. I'll approve after perf harness run attached.
Carla: will draft the customer blurb and post to PS for review once PR merges. also adding a note to the postmortem about recurrence so oncall sees history.
Gita: timeline agreed: triage -> PR -> canary (48-72h) -> staged rollout. target resolution date: 2026-04-08.
Lin: merging after perf test pass. I will own canary and monitoring during the rollout window.
Omar: will hand off final triage artifacts and traces to Lin after validation.
Carla: i'll watch the new alerts during canary and escalate if we see memory creep. :eyes:
Gita: thanks everyone  leaving thread open for blockers or changes.
